source: Census Survey of Business Owners (SBO) — American Indian & Alaska Native-Owned Firms (1987–2007)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau (economic census program; interpretive briefs via MBDA)
native_identifiability: Aggregate historical time series of AIAN-owned firm COUNTS and RECEIPTS by industry and state: 52,980 firms/$3.7B (1987) -> 102,234/$8.1B (1992) -> ~201,400/$26.9B (2002) -> 236,967/$34.4B (2007); construction + retail dominant
identity_semantics: Aggregate CONTEXT only, never an entity roster — counts/receipts, not business names (fits the aggregate-only constraint; no business-level access implied). Self-identified AIAN ownership per Census definition (≥51%). SBO counts ALL firms, employer AND nonemployer — this is the number that makes the 2000s totals large
export: Census library publication tables + charts (PDF/HTML); historical, not an API series
notes: NEW FRAME: historical archives. This is the deep-time backbone (back to 1987) for the 'how many / what industries / over time' article framing the owner described — the aggregate complement to the entity-level registry. Coverage Frame class. nation_ids: [] (national aggregate).

source: Census Annual Business Survey (ABS) — AIAN-owned businesses (2017–present)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau + NCSES/NSF (ABS, successor to SBO)
native_identifiability: Modern annual continuation: 2021 = 48,582 AIAN-owned EMPLOYER businesses / $54.4B receipts / 307,933 employees; 2022 = 47,519 / $78.5B / 333,153 employees; by industry, state, and owner characteristics; queryable via data.census.gov and the Census API
identity_semantics: Aggregate context via data.census.gov / API. CRITICAL METHODOLOGY BREAK vs SBO: ABS counts EMPLOYER firms only (~47k), while SBO counted employer + nonemployer (~237k in 2007). do_not_infer a collapse by comparing the two series naively — they measure different universes. Nonemployer AIAN firms (~378k) live in a separate product (Nonemployer Statistics by Demographics, NES-D)
export: data.census.gov + Census Bureau API (aggregate tables); NSF/NCSES co-publishes
notes: The live continuation of the SBO backbone, API-accessible for the aggregate layer. Pair with SBO (1987-2007) for a ~35-year series, but keep the employer/nonemployer break explicit. Nonemployer side = NES-D (a future lead). nation_ids: [] (national aggregate).
